action: For awareness. Shorten patch windows for internet-facing software and use Mandiant's hardening guide for LLM-enabled attack tooling, which Google's report points to.
exec: State-linked groups are investing in automated espionage tooling, which may increase the speed and volume of intrusions.
plain: Google reported that a hacking group linked to China is building its own automated attack tool, probably for spying. Google does not name the group.

key_findings: Google reports evidence that a PRC-nexus group was building its own automated attack framework, likely for cyber espionage; it names neither the group nor the tool.
PRC-nexus actors used LLMs in Q3 2026 for reconnaissance, scanning, target research and exploit weaponisation.
LEAKY CASTLE, described as a PRC contractor, used LLMs to turn exfiltrated data into finished intelligence reports.
PRC actors also abused LLM platforms' file-hosting backends for staging, dead-drop command and control and exfiltration.
Suspected PRC-nexus espionage actors are among those experimenting with open-source agentic frameworks such as ARTEX, CAIRN and PentAGI.
recommendations: Use Mandiant's published hardening guide and defence framework for machine-speed, LLM-enabled offensive tooling.
Shorten patch windows, because LLMs are compressing the time from disclosure to working exploit.

summary: Google's November 16 AI Threat Tracker reports evidence that a PRC-nexus group was developing its own automated attack framework, likely for espionage. Google does not name the group or tie the tool to ARTEX. The report also describes PRC-nexus use of LLMs for reconnaissance and exploit work, and a contractor, LEAKY CASTLE, using them to analyse stolen data.
title: Google: Chinese state group is developing an automated attack tool for espionage

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Google Threat Intelligence Group document.

review.note: Compared with Google GTIG report: exact PRC-nexus framework wording, group unnamed, no ARTEX tie, LEAKY CASTLE, LLM uses; Google named as source
